app lidarr_log radarr_log sonarr_log prowlarr_log postgres template0 template1

set -e
echo "Starting stats refresh at $(date)"

response=$(curl -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-api-key: $${REFRESH_STATS_API_KEY}" \
  -w "\n%{http_code}" \
  -s \
  https://$${SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID}.supabase.co/functions/v1/refresh-stats)

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

echo "Response: $body"
echo "HTTP Status: $http_code"

if [ "$http_code" != "200" ]; then
  echo "Error: Stats refresh failed with status $http_code"
  exit 1
fi

echo "Stats refresh completed successfully at $(date)"
